instruction:
Inspect the proposed change and authorized relevant product material without editing
the product. Separate feasible options, unknown facts and authority limits. Write
the artifact matching the selected result. Do not start implementation, create a
release or infer permission to broaden the assignment.

assessment.name: assessment
assessment.expectation: Feasible approach, evidence, risks, constraints and recommended next decision.

discovery.name: discovery
discovery.expectation: Unknown facts, why each is necessary, bounded ways to establish them and blocked conclusions.

boundary.name: boundary
boundary.expectation: Exact scope conflict, evidence and decision needed to proceed.

feasible.name: feasible
feasible.when: Scope is authorized and enough evidence supports a feasible approach.

needs-discovery.name: needs-discovery
needs-discovery.when: Scope is authorized but necessary technical facts are unknown.

outside-scope.name: outside-scope
outside-scope.when: The requested assessment itself exceeds the authorized assignment.

prerequisite_assessment.author: Codex host /root
prerequisite_assessment.evidence: Selected installed solution-architect; current accepted workflow design and implementation scope supply agreed requirements. Pilot only assesses actual feasibility, writes declared attempt artifact, uses workspace read tools and does not change product or integrations.

readiness.authority: User: OK, now implement the workflow agents and the whole design. Read-only implementation pilot within current Activity.
